title: {n} date ideas for a cold night
intro: Magic, a 94th-floor view, a Russian bathhouse and jazz, all indoors. Every one is open until 9 pm or later on Fridays and Saturdays.

entries.blurb: Close-up and stage magic happen in hidden rooms, bars and small theaters inside a historic stone mansion off the Mag Mile, and you move through the house as the night goes on. Make it a dressed-up dinner-and-magic night, or catch a lighter one-hour show in the Vault.
entries.source: blurb: description, highlights; price_unit: price_note ('$75 food and drink credit per person')

entries.blurb: An observation deck on the 94th floor of the former John Hancock Tower, with views over the lake and the Magnificent Mile. Its TILT ride leans you out over the edge of the building inside a glass wall.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('GA $27 adult / $19 child')

entries.blurb: Chicago's old Russian-style bathhouse on Division Street, operating since 1906, with a sauna, a lounge, and a restaurant and full bar. The classic add-on is a platza, where soaked birch, oak or eucalyptus leaves are used on you in the heat.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Day admission $50 per adult')

entries.blurb: A 1920s-era speakeasy in the basement of the Green Door Tavern, where the cocktail menu is printed on tarot cards and rotates through more than 100 drinks. Small live acts pop up through the evening.
entries.source: blurb: description, highlights; price_unit: price_note says only 'Pay per drink' (no admission price)

entries.blurb: A River North jazz club and restaurant with three live jazz sets a night, so dinner and a show happen at one table.
entries.source: blurb: hook, description, highlights ('Dinner + show date'); price_unit: price_note ('$20 per guest per show')

entries.blurb: Your own darts booth with a screen that scores every throw, so beginners can play against experts.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('From $15 per person')

entries.blurb: Borrow any game from walls of board games, order cocktails and food from your table, and let staff help you pick.
entries.source: blurb: hook, description; price_unit: price_note ('$7 per person game fee')

entries.blurb: Private escape rooms, including The Onyx Tower, a 45-minute room for just two people.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note says 'likely per person' and the official page (paniqescaperoom.com/chicago, fetched 2026-11-14) does not say per person or per group

entries.blurb: Tuft your own rug with a tufting gun, or mix a custom lipstick or candle, and take it home. A popular BYOB date night.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: official page (popcraftstudio.com, fetched 2026-11-14) prices per item made, not per person or group

entries.blurb: Full-body, free-roam virtual reality that your group plays together, such as a dinosaur adventure.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note says 'likely per person' and the official page (sandboxvr.com/chicago/lincoln-common, fetched 2026-11-14) does not say

title: Open on Thanksgiving: {n} ideas
intro: Every place here has posted hours for Thanksgiving Day: markets, skating, afternoon tea and a glass box 103 floors up.

entries.blurb: Giant inflatable art installations by more than a dozen international artists fill The Fields Studios in Avondale. You walk through, touch and play in them, and each room is built around a feeling.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('adults 18-65 from $41.20 ... kids 3-11 from $31.99'); date: date_hours 2026-11-26 10:00-19:00

entries.blurb: Chicago's big German-style Christmas market fills Daley Plaza for its 30th season, with rows of wooden huts selling ornaments and handmade gifts. The classic order is Glühwein in the collectible yearly souvenir mug.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_level free, price_note 'Free admission'; date: date_hours 2026-11-26 11:00-16:00, season 2026-11-20..2026-12-24

entries.blurb: The observation deck at the top of Willis Tower, with a Chicago museum exhibit and a fast elevator ride. The star is The Ledge: glass boxes that stick out from the 103rd floor, so you stand on glass 1,353 feet up.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: age_note ('adult price 12+, ages 3-11 youth price, under 3 free'); date: date_hours 2026-11-26 09:00-20:00

entries.blurb: Classic afternoon tea in the Drake Hotel's Palm Court, a Gold Coast tradition, with tea sandwiches, warm scones and a pastry plate. The holiday version adds a live harpist, plus carolers on set days.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('$87 adult ... $39 child', 'refills $30 per person'); date: date_hours 2026-11-26 11:00-18:00

entries.blurb: A winding ice path that loops through Maggie Daley Park with the skyline all around.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Ticket incl. skate rental', priced per ticket, own skates $5); date: date_hours 2026-11-26 three sessions 08:00-16:00, season 2026-11-13..2027-03-07

entries.blurb: The Christkindlmarket's holiday huts on Gallagher Way next to Wrigley Field, with German-style food, warm drinks and gift stalls.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_level free; date: date_hours 2026-11-26 11:00-16:00, season 2026-11-20..2026-12-31

entries.blurb: Trails and scenic drives through a huge tree museum in west-suburban Lisle, good for a crisp-weather walk.
entries.source: blurb: hook, description; price_unit: price_note gives no unit and the official page (mortonarb.org/visit, fetched 2026-11-14) lists no prices; date: date_hours 2026-11-26 09:00-16:20

entries.blurb: Target golf scored like a game from a private bay with food and drinks, easy for people who have never golfed.
entries.source: blurb: hook, description; price_unit: official page (topgolf.com/us/schaumburg, fetched 2026-11-14) shows 'Hourly Bay Pricing' (priced per bay per hour, amounts not shown); date: date_hours 2026-11-26 15:00-22:00

title: {n} holiday light shows
intro: Walk-through trails, drive-thrus, a lit Japanese garden and a heated boat past the lights. Each runs for weeks, but many skip Thanksgiving and Christmas.

entries.blurb: A 1.3-mile walking trail of large light-art installations set to music, winding through the Chicago Botanic Garden in Glencoe.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('$3 nonmember service fee per ticket; under 3 free')

entries.blurb: A half-mile walk through Cantigny's gardens lit with music-timed displays, floral sculptures and a 28-foot Christmas tree. There's an ice rink with rinkside cocoa cabanas, and a drinks add-on puts seasonal cocktails at stops along the route.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Adults $18 on weeknights ... kids 4-15 $10-$15')

entries.blurb: Lincoln Park Zoo turns its grounds into a walk-through holiday light show in the evenings.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: official page (lpzoo.org/event/zoolights, fetched 2026-11-14): 'every individual in your party, including children, must have a ticket', gate tickets '$20 each'

entries.blurb: Rockford's Japanese garden glows after dark with up-lit trees and thousands of white lights reflected in its ponds. Warm up after with woodfire pizza and a drink fireside in the Visitors Center.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Adults $15, seniors $14, students and military $13')

entries.blurb: Drive about two miles of lights through Northwestern Medicine Field, synchronized to music you tune in on your car radio. It's billed as Chicago's longest-running drive-thru light show.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note ('$49.99 per carload of up to 6')

entries.blurb: The Morton Arboretum lights up its trees along a one-mile paved trail of light and music installations, now in its 14th season.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Adults from $22 nonmembers', 'about $20-$34 per adult')

entries.blurb: More than 50 trees and displays fill the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry, each decorated by community volunteers to share their family and cultural holiday traditions. There's also an indoor forest, light displays and a four-story Grand Tree.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note (general admission, '$9 off adults and $5 off kids 3-11')

entries.blurb: A 40-minute evening cruise on an enclosed, heated historic boat past holiday light displays along the Geneva Lake shore to Santa's lakeside hideaway. Santa's Bar at the harbor festival serves drinks before or after.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Classic cruise $25 adults, $15 children')

entries.blurb: Brookfield Zoo Chicago's long-running holiday lights festival, spread across the zoo grounds.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note 'From $29.95' with no unit, and the official page (brookfieldzoo.org/holidaymagic, fetched 2026-11-14) says only 'Tickets starting at $29.95'

entries.blurb: A drive-through light display on the roads of Aurora's Phillips Park, now in its 20th year, so you stay warm in the car.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_level free, price_note 'Free; volunteers collect free-will donations'

title: {n} ice rinks, ranked
intro: A skyline ice ribbon, an indoor holiday rink and six free park rinks. Maggie Daley is skating now; most others open Nov 27.

entries.blurb: A winding ice path that loops through Maggie Daley Park with the skyline all around. One of Chicago's signature winter dates.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note ('Ticket incl. skate rental'), good_to_know

entries.blurb: An indoor holiday playground in Navy Pier's Festival Hall with its own ice rink, and skating comes with every ticket. A good bad-weather pick.
entries.source: blurb: description, highlights; price_unit: good_to_know ('ages 3+ need a ticket')

entries.blurb: A Park District rink on the Midway Plaisance in Hyde Park, next to the University of Chicago. It hosts themed nights such as a community bonfire, a holiday skate with Santa, glow skates and a Valentine's skate. Free sessions need pre-registration.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_level free, price_note ('Open skate free with own skates')

entries.blurb: A winter rink on the central lawn of Parkway Bank Park, Rosemont's entertainment district near O'Hare. About 15 restaurants and venues ring the lawn, including Kings bowling and iFLY indoor skydiving, so it's easy to combine skating with dinner or another activity.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_level free, price_note ('Free skating')

entries.blurb: A Park District outdoor rink in West Ridge's Warren Park, ringed by trees, with skate walkers for beginners.
entries.source: blurb: description, highlights; price_unit: price_level free, price_note

entries.blurb: A Park District outdoor rink on the far Southwest Side, lit for evening skating, with drop-in learn-to-skate and pond hockey.
entries.source: blurb: description, highlights; price_unit: price_level free, price_note

entries.blurb: A Park District outdoor rink in McKinley Park on the Southwest Side, an easy low-key winter outing.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_level free, price_note

entries.blurb: A Park District outdoor rink near Midway Airport, with drop-in learn-to-skate, stick-and-puck and adult rat hockey.
entries.source: blurb: description, highlights; price_unit: price_level free, price_note

title: {n} free things to do indoors
intro: Stained-glass domes, old glasshouses, rare books and a museum inside the Federal Reserve. All free; the Lincoln Park Conservatory needs a free timed-entry reservation.

entries.blurb: A Loop landmark built over 100 years ago as the city's first public library and a Civil War memorial, with two stained-glass domes, including the Tiffany dome in Preston Bradley Hall. The city runs music, dance, film, lecture and art events here year-round.
entries.source: blurb: description, highlights; price_unit: price_note ('Free admission')

entries.blurb: The University of Chicago's art museum, now showing a teamLab installation alongside 'Nina Chanel Abney: Between Us' and 'How Do We Heal?'. An easy 30-45 minute loop, with Robie House and Rockefeller Chapel a few blocks away.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Always free')

entries.blurb: A Pilsen museum dedicated to Mexican and Mexican-American art and culture, an easy pairing with a meal or coffee in Pilsen afterward.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Admission is always free')

entries.blurb: A walk-in museum on the first floor of the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago in the Loop, all about money and how the Fed works.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Free')

entries.blurb: A glass conservatory built in stages between 1890 and 1895, a short walk from Lincoln Park Zoo and the Nature Museum. Combine it with the zoo and the butterfly haven for a full afternoon. Reserve a free timed-entry slot first.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Free; reservation required')

entries.blurb: A glasshouse with more than 3,000 plants, some dating to its founding in 1929, along winding stone paths through tropical greenery. A quiet, warm, green place to sit in the middle of winter.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Free; suggested donation')

entries.blurb: A glass-roofed hall on the top floor of Chicago's main public library, with daylight pouring in all year and greenery. A calm warm-up stop on a cold Loop day, next to the Special Collections exhibit hall.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Free (public library)')

entries.blurb: A grand research library across from Washington Square Park whose galleries anyone can walk into, with changing shows of rare books, maps and manuscripts. Guided building tours run on some days.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Admission is always free')

entries.blurb: The home of Poetry magazine, reached through a tree-lined courtyard in a building designed to unfold step by step 'like a poem'. Inside is a public poetry library and gallery for a quiet read, plus readings and music.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Free; events free')

entries.blurb: A photography museum at Columbia College Chicago across from Grant Park, with changing exhibitions that make a compact 30-45 minute visit.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('MoCP is free')

title: {n} things for $20 or less each
intro: Board games, darts, a cat arcade, a distillery tour and live jazz. Each one starts at $20 or less per person.

entries.blurb: A cat rescue lounge in Lakeview where adoptable cats roam free among retro arcade games. Every cat can be adopted through the rescue, and it also runs cat yoga.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note ('$20 per person per hour')

entries.blurb: A board game bar with walls of games you can borrow, and staff help pick one for your group.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note ('$7 per person game fee')

entries.blurb: A London-born darts bar where your group gets its own oche (a private throwing booth) and a screen that scores every throw, so beginners can play against experts.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('From $15 per person')

entries.blurb: A neon-lit shuffleboard bar from London where the tables score themselves, with four game modes and replays, so nobody argues about whose puck counts. Food and drinks come to your table while you play.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('$20 per person for 90 minutes')

entries.blurb: A working grain-to-bottle distillery in Ravenswood. You watch production from a viewing platform, hear how the whiskey is made, then taste three KOVAL spirits.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('$12 per person per tour')

entries.blurb: A small Oak Brook museum devoted to cutting and carving stone: jade carvings, gemstones, cameos, mosaics, fossils and dioramas. The showpiece is Castle Lizzadro.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Adults $10')

entries.blurb: A relaxed Rogers Park cafe with more than 450 board games to borrow, a kitchen for snacks and drinks, and BYOB.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note ('$10 per person gaming fee')

entries.blurb: A ping pong bar in the Loop with rows of orange tables, where groups rally and play doubles over cocktails, beginners welcome.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note ('Ping pong $10 per person')

entries.blurb: Indoor mini golf with smart balls that keep score for you, and trick holes that make it more competitive than classic putt-putt.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note ('9 holes per player')

entries.blurb: Three live jazz sets a night at a River North club and restaurant, a dinner-and-show date.
entries.source: blurb: hook, description, highlights; price_unit: price_note ('$20 per guest per show')

title: Still open after 11: {n} ideas
intro: Blues, jazz, magic at your table, saunas, karaoke and arcades. Each is open past 11 pm on Fridays and Saturdays.

entries.blurb: A late-night blues club in Lincoln Park with two stages that trade sets all night, so the music barely stops. An early acoustic set starts the night.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note gives cover without a unit; official FAQ also gives no unit

entries.blurb: Uptown's long-running jazz bar at Lawrence and Broadway, with live music every night, from early-evening sets to swing orchestras and very late jam sessions.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Cover varies by show')

entries.blurb: A magic club and cocktail lounge in Andersonville whose lineup of magicians rotates weekly. In the speakeasy-style Performance Bar, magicians do close-up tricks at your table while you have drinks and small plates.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note has no amount or unit

entries.blurb: A big Korean-style bathhouse in Niles with nine themed sauna rooms, from a gold pyramid and a Himalayan salt sauna to a 35 F ice room and an oak-fired Fire Sudatorium. The lounges are co-ed in spa clothes, and there is a Korean restaurant.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note and official pricing page give the day pass without a per-person unit

entries.blurb: A Russian-style bathhouse on Division Street since 1906, with a sauna, a lounge and a full bar. The classic add-on is a platza, where soaked birch, oak or eucalyptus leaves are used on you in the heat.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note ('Day admission $50 per adult')

entries.blurb: Home of WhirlyBall, a team game in electric bumper cars where you scoop and throw a ball, like lacrosse, hockey and basketball on wheels. There's also laser tag, bowling and more than 30 craft beer taps.
entries.source: blurb: description, hook; price_unit: price_note points to a pricing PDF, no unit

entries.blurb: A second-floor karaoke lounge in Chinatown with 12 private rooms, song catalogs in several languages and Asian-inspired pub food.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Hourly room rental')

entries.blurb: A Logan Square bar with more than eighty well-kept pinball machines and arcade games, plus a pinball league and a Killer Queen night.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Pay per game (price per play not listed)')

entries.blurb: The closest Round1 to the city: a big Japanese-style arcade full of rhythm, claw and prize games, with bowling, billiards and private karaoke rooms under one roof.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('prices not posted')

entries.blurb: A huge Schaumburg entertainment center with four electric go-kart tracks, more than 150 arcade games, laser tag, Hologate VR and bowling.
entries.source: blurb: description; price_unit: price_note ('Adult or intermediate 3-race pack'), highlights ('individual racers')
